name: MER-UniBench
description: MER-UniBench is a unified benchmark for multimodal large language models focused on emotion understanding. It includes the MER-Caption dataset with over 115K samples and 2K fine-grained emotion categories, supporting both typical MER tasks and free-form natural language outputs.
reputation: A recent unified benchmark that is gaining attention in multimodal emotion understanding research, especially for evaluating MLLMs on fine-grained emotion recognition and generation.
notes: Includes AffectGPT model and MER-Caption dataset; uses model-based crowd-sourcing for data collection.
